The present Writ Petition is filed for the following relief:
 "...to issue an appropriate Writ, order or direction more particulariy  one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the inaction of the  respondent No.2 in renewing the Passport bearing No.M9639115  issued in my favour referring to crime in FiR No.402/2022 on the file  of Taluk U/G Police Station, Kadapa, YSR District registered for the  offences punishable under Sections 323, 324, 506 R/w 34 of Indian  Penal Code, 1860 as illegal, arbitrary,, contrary to the provisions of  the Passport Act, 1967 and the well established legal principles laid  down by this Hon'ble Court as well as the Hon'ble Apex Court from  time to time apart from being violative of the fundamental rights  guaranteed to me under Articles 14,19 and 21 of the Constitution of  India and consequently direct the respondent No.2 to renew the  Passport bearing No. M9639115 issued in my favour for a further  period of 10 years without referring to the crime in FIR.No.402/2022  on the file of Taluk U/G Police Station, Kadapa, YSR District and  pass such other order or orders..."

2. Heard learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home and Ms.Divya Datia, learned Standing Counsel appearing for respondent nos.1 & 2.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that even though the petitioner submitted an application for renewal of the Passport bearing Passport No.M9639115 before respondent No,2, it is kept pending on the ground that F.I.R.No.402 of 2022 is pending before respondent no.3 Police Station.
He further submits that the said crime is at the investigation stage and the petitioner is entitled for renewal of the Passport.
